pages.title: Claim Your Rewards
pages.text: Open Rewards from the main panel. Entries show required trust and whether a reward is available or already claimed. Claim it when eligible.$(br2)Defaults:$(br)2: Lore Handbook + Fragment 1$(br)10: two Totems$(br)20: Abyssal Gaze$(br)30: 32 Diamonds

pages.title: Growing Trust
pages.text: Later rewards:$(br)50: Soul Bound Pact$(br)75: Transcendence Permit$(br)100: Poem of the End$(br2)First recordings of a fragment queue 20 trust. Duplicates can fill a new handbook without extra trust.$(br2)Modpacks may change these rewards.
